items.title: Zabbix → Nowlert CE → Discord
items.summary: Nowlert isn’t limited to SMTP. Infrastructure and monitoring platforms that can send HTTP events can use the same notification pipeline.

items.title: Dell iDRAC / Redfish → Nowlert
items.summary: Your servers already report hardware events. With Redfish Event Service, those events can become part of the same notification pipeline as the rest of your infrastructure.

items.title: Centralise homelab SMTP alerts
items.summary: A lot of infrastructure already knows how to send email. Hypervisors, storage systems, network appliances and other infrastructure can generate SMTP notifications without needing another monitoring agent.

items.title: Xen Orchestra → Nowlert CE → Discord
items.summary: Infrastructure systems generate useful information every day. The problem is often how that information reaches you.

items.title: Infrastructure reports. Nowlert delivers.
items.summary: We built Nowlert from a practical infrastructure problem: useful alerts already existed, but they arrived in different formats, through different transports, and often took too long to understand.
